# Babel tests we intentionally skip.
# These are intentional language differences, not bugs.
#
# Format:
#   # comment explaining why tests below are skipped
#   test-name-1
#   test-name-2
#
#   another-test # inline comment also works

# the "with" object shape in imports is a typing concern, not a separate error
# (in theory we could also validate this in the tests but seems annoying, we have separate tests)
typescript/types/invalid-import-type-dynamic-with-jsx-options
typescript/types/invalid-import-type-options-string-with
typescript/types/invalid-import-type-options-trailing-comma
typescript/types/invalid-import-type-options-with-computed-properties
typescript/types/invalid-import-type-options-with-spread-element
typescript/types/invalid-import-type-trailing-comma

# operator restrictions are enforced via type checking (not "early" syntax)
typescript/exponentiation/await-non-null-before-exponential

# allow namespace declarations without `declare` prefix (we're a bit more permissive)
typescript/module-namespace/module-declare-new-line
typescript/module-namespace/namespace-declare-new-line

# babel-specific JSX restrictions (we allow sequence expressions in JSX containers)
jsx/errors/sequence-expression
jsx/errors/attribute-sequence-expression

# babel rejects arrow functions in ternary branches without parentheses
typescript/arrow-function/arrow-like-in-conditional-2
